evidence: Searched the reply (lines 1-15) and both written files for cost, retention, credentials/access, download mechanism, URL scheme, metric, date of change, outcome and alternatives. The new doc states only the storage move ('Bucket S3', line 19) and the user's reason (lines 23, 27). Credentials and retention appear only as a restatement attributed to the original ('O design original já apontava o que o bucket exigiria: credenciais e política de retenção novas.', line 33). Production date, download path, retention, old files, other alternatives and trade-offs are all listed under Questões em aberto (lines 37-42). The dates 2026-11-16 are document metadata (Criado em / Última atualização), not the date of the change. The line 'O resto do design original continua valendo, exceto onde este documento diz o contrário' (line 13) is a scoping sentence that names no specific mechanism, policy or cost.

Searched both written files and the reply for any statement of who or what serves GET /exports/<job_id>/download after the change. It shows up only in past-tense descriptions of the 404 (new doc line 23) and as an open question ('Quem serve o `GET /exports/<job_id>/download` hoje, e como ele entrega o arquivo ao usuário?', new doc line 38; reply line 9). The original doc's Solução section is unchanged and is not text written in this run.

New doc line 27: 'Não fazer nada. Descartada: com dois workers, o download devolvia 404 sempre que a request caía no worker que não gerou o arquivo.' The reason uses only the second worker, the download reaching the worker without the file, and the 404, which matches the MET anchor. Searched it for support tickets, cost or any team evaluation and found none.
